summary:
This repository is a React + Vite account signup demo (`src/pages/Signup.jsx`, `Login.jsx`, `Welcome.jsx`, router in `src/router.jsx`). It is not the Angular "Tutorial Manager" app the request describes — there is no Angular, no `AppModule`, no Bootstrap, no navbar, and no tutorials entity or service anywhere in it. So only item 4, which is generic visual polish, applies here; I took the smaller reading and applied it to the files this repo actually has rather than inventing an Angular app or a tutorials CRUD UI.

What I changed:
- `index.html` — linked the Inter Google font (with preconnects). The request names `src/index.html`; this Vite project's equivalent is the root `index.html`.
- `src/style.css` — the project's existing shared stylesheet (there is no `src/styles.css`, and creating a second one would split the styles). Light grey page background, Inter as the base family, one consistent indigo accent scheme with hover/active/focus states, consistent radii and spacing tokens, softer card shadow, rounded inputs with a focus glow ring, and smooth transitions on inputs, buttons and links.

Visual only — no component logic, no page markup, no dependency changes. Build passes. No password field was touched, so the recorded password-rules conventions did not come into play; the accent/error/ok colour tokens those rules render with are preserved by name so any future `PasswordRules` hint list picks up the new scheme.
blockers: Not applied -- 1. HeaderComponent in src/app/components/header/ declared in AppModule, gradient navbar with Tutorial Manager logo and Tutorials / Add Tutorial links, plus a footer: This repo is a React + Vite signup demo with no Angular, no AppModule and no navbar; building it would mean inventing an unrelated app rather than restyling this one

Not applied -- 2. Tutorials list card grid with pill badges, search bar, empty state and red Remove All button: No tutorials entity, list page, service or data exist in this repository, and the request forbids adding services/component logic

Not applied -- 3. Add/Edit tutorial pages as centered cards with Bootstrap alerts: No Add/Edit tutorial pages exist here; the existing signup/login/welcome pages are already centered cards and were restyled under item 4

Not applied -- Keep Bootstrap 4 and NgModule; update existing component tests: Bootstrap and Angular are not dependencies here and there are no component tests in this repository (only a Playwright devDependency with no specs); changes were CSS-only so no test needed updating

Visual verification failed: The app is a React signup/login demo, not the Angular Tutorial Manager the instruction describes; the change only restyled src/style.css and added the Inter font link, so the rendered /login page shows a polished card but there is no gradient navbar/HeaderComponent, no footer, no tutorials card grid with search bar and Published/Pending pills, and no Add/Edit pages. Only item 4 (light grey background, Inter font, consistent scheme) is visibly satisfied.

context_sharing.notes: This app has no HTTP API: accounts are stored client-side in localStorage under the key 'acme-users' (keyed by lowercased, trimmed email) and the signed-in email in sessionStorage under 'acme-current'. The only paths are client-side routes '/signup', '/login', '/welcome' (unknown paths fall back to Signup); the Signup form also has a 'confirm' (string) field that is validated locally and never persisted.
